services.name: SceneResource_InitializeActiveScene
services.behavior: When the active-scene entry gate is set, clears/rebuilds VDP state, initializes the scene-backed actors, runs the initial service pass, uploads the palette band, and enters the recurring frame service.

services.name: SceneResource_InitializeScriptTransition
services.behavior: Called by SceneScript_AdvanceState when the scene-script transition gate is set; clears transition state and actor resources, copies the scene presentation, loads the selected VRAM resources, initializes the transition actor at (0x40, 0x1B8), runs the initial service passes, and queues the transition audio command when required.

services.name: SceneResource_RebuildAfterInteraction
services.behavior: When SCENE_STATE is not 0x0A and PLAYER_INTERACTION_COUNTER is nonzero, resets the scene/resource presentation, clears and reinitializes actors, loads fixed resources, renders initial frames, and continues through the frame loop.

services.name: SceneResource_ProcessCommandStreams
services.behavior: Invokes SceneResource_ProcessCommandStream twice for the active state.

services.name: Camera_RebuildView
services.behavior: In special mode writes the complete 16-by-23 terrain viewport; otherwise performs paired right/left 0x10-pixel camera sweeps with actor VM, interaction-row, and sprite service work.

services.name: Hud_ResetDisplayDigits
services.behavior: During reset and active-scene setup, writes six ASCII zero digits to the display buffer at 0x00FF7E29 and terminates it with a NUL.

services.name: Game_InitializeDifficultyCounter
services.behavior: Selects the initial ASCII counter value at 0x00FF7E3C from GAME_DIFFICULTY_MODE: '5' for mode 0, '3' for mode 1, and '2' otherwise, then clears 0x00FF7E3D.

conclusion: The scene/resource entrypoints and camera rebuild path are now distinct from the lower-level VDP transfer, actor initialization, recurring service helpers, and startup display-state helpers they orchestrate.
